basis: Original pixels only. No manifest, context, spec, receipts or author report read.

panels.description: One upright black-on-white tapered outline, apex high near horizontal center, large oval outline below, smaller oval outline around midheight. No separate subpanels, axes, grid, dimensions, numbers or angle marks.

pointLoci.visible: Common high junction of outer sloping boundaries, an interior left sloping stroke, an interior right sloping stroke, and a near-vertical central stroke. No distinct isolated dot.
Lower-left/front oval boundary meets the interior left sloping stroke and the diagonal dashed lower line. A-shaped glyph below-left.

Near upper-right part of the large oval: the rising diagonal dashed lower line reaches the right sloping region; descending dashed inner-right stroke reaches this region. B-shaped glyph above-right. Heavy strokes prevent subpixel endpoint separation.
Lower-left portion of smaller oval meets interior left sloping line and rising solid diagonal across the oval. A-shaped label with a small appended lower-right stroke lies above/near this junction.
Upper-right portion of smaller oval meets rising solid diagonal and right sloping region. B-shaped label with small lower-right mark is above-right.
Solid central upright stroke crosses solid rising diagonal inside smaller oval. O-shaped loop plus small lower-right hooked mark printed to the right.
Dashed near-vertical center stroke meets/crosses dashed rising diagonal inside large oval. O/zero-shaped loop printed below-right; no appended suffix clearly visible.

sourceRequirements: Keep the single shared tapered frame, both oval outlines and all seven label loci.
Keep the relative apex, upper/lower left/right and central junction positions; preserve both diagonal spans and their crossings with the central stroke.

Keep the distinct solid smaller oval, solid larger front oval arc, dashed larger rear arc, solid upper diagonal, dashed lower diagonal, solid left interior slope and dashed lower right interior slope.
Do not convert uncertain suffix shapes into certain source codepoints or infer coplanarity, perpendicularity, center/radius, parallelism or incidence beyond the visible junctions.

uncertainties.detail: Three appended marks resemble reduced 1-like glyphs but their exact identity is not a source-pixel certainty.
Lookalike capital shapes do not prove Unicode codepoints; O-like loops do not distinguish letter O from zero.
Heavy outer-right stroke, upper oval and interior-right strokes crowd one another; no exact hidden-line continuation or subpixel endpoint can be inferred.
Central upper solid and lower dashed segments are visible, but the precise style-transition endpoint is partly hidden by the smaller oval.
